# Third-party sources

PCRE2 10.30 is distributed under its included `pcre2/LICENCE`.
DXBC utilities and ShaderRegex reference sources come from
SpectrumQT/XXMI-Libs-Package, commit
`065dc746c21c71ef48bbc93cb6b90b3dcdf766e6`; their GPL notices are
in `dxbc/COPYING.txt` and `dxbc/LICENSE.GPL.txt`.

The TexFx adaptations retain their separate CC BY-SA 4.0 licenses and
author credits in `texfx-diffuse`, `texfx-outline` and `texfx-overlay`.
The SoftwareMouse shader source is adapted from GIMI's `Mouse.hlsl`.
TextPrinter attribution is retained in `textprinter/LICENSE`.

These dependencies and adaptations keep their original license terms.
